_delete_this_line: This is a fake example showing the schema. Delete it when your first real cadence step is generated.
_schema_notes: One row per planned touch. day_offset: 1 | 3 | 7 | 11 (business days from anchor_date). channel: email | linkedin | other. kind: intro | followup_detail | followup_angle | close_loop | connect_note. status: pending | drafted | approved | sent | skipped | stopped. Steps auto-skip when their data is missing (no verified email = no email step; no LinkedIn URL = no connect step).
